title: Unknown name
explanation: Java can't find this variable, method or class. Check spelling and capitalization, that it's declared in scope, and that you imported it (e.g. import java.util.Scanner;).
where: The line under 'symbol:' in the error.

title: Wrong type
explanation: You're assigning or returning a value of a different type than declared. Converting may need a cast or a method like Integer.parseInt().
where: Both sides of the assignment or the return statement.

title: Possible lossy conversion
explanation: Putting a wider type into a narrower one could lose information, so Java requires an explicit cast like (int) value.
where: The assignment on the reported line.

title: Missing return
explanation: A method that declares a return type must return a value on every path, including after loops and in every if/else branch.
where: The end of the method and each branch.

pattern: class (\w+) is public, should be declared in a file named
title: Public class name must match the file
explanation: A public class must live in a file with the same name. In Code Dojo the file is Main.java, so the public class must be called Main.
where: The 'public class' line.

title: Missing semicolon
explanation: Statements in Java end with ;.
where: The end of the reported line (or the one before).

title: Missing closing parenthesis
explanation: A ( was opened without a matching ).
where: Count parentheses on the reported line.

pattern: error: reached end of file while parsing
title: Missing closing brace
explanation: A { was opened but never closed with }.
where: Match braces of the class and each method.

title: Code in the wrong place
explanation: Usually a missing } so that a method ended up inside another, or a statement written outside any method.
where: Braces just before the reported line.

pattern: error: class, interface, enum, or record expected
title: Code outside the class
explanation: There's code after the class's closing brace, often because of an extra }.
where: Braces near the reported line.

pattern: variable (\w+) might not have been initialized
title: Variable used before it has a value
explanation: Local variables need a value before they're read. Initialize it when you declare it (int sum = 0;).
where: The declaration of the variable.

title: Variable declared twice
explanation: You declared the same name twice in one scope. Drop the type the second time to reuse it.
where: Both declarations.

pattern: non-static (method|variable) (\w+).* cannot be referenced from a static context
title: Using an instance member from static main
explanation: main is static, so it can't use non-static methods or fields directly. Make the helper static, or create an object first.
where: The method or field's declaration — add static, or call it on an object.

pattern: unreported exception (\w+); must be caught or declared to be thrown
title: Checked exception not handled
explanation: This call can throw a checked exception. Wrap it in try/catch or add 'throws' to the method.
where: The call on the reported line.

title: Can't create an abstract class or interface
explanation: You can't use new on an abstract class or interface. Create an object of a concrete class that implements it.
where: The new expression.

pattern: is not abstract and does not override abstract method (\w+)
title: Interface method not implemented
explanation: A class that implements an interface must provide every method it declares, with the same signature.
where: The class declaration and the interface's methods.

pattern: error: method (\w+) in class (\w+) cannot be applied to given types
title: Wrong arguments
explanation: The method was called with arguments of different number or types than its parameters.
where: Compare the call with the method's signature (shown under 'required:' and 'found:').

title: Comparing strings with ==
explanation: == checks whether two references are the same object, not whether the text is equal. Use a.equals(b).
where: Comparisons between strings.

title: Null pointer
explanation: You called a method or read a field on a reference that is null — an object never created with new, or an array element never filled.
where: The line after 'at Main.' in the stack trace; check which reference is null.

title: Array index out of range
explanation: Valid indices run from 0 to length - 1. Loops should use i < arr.length, not <=.
where: The line in the stack trace and the index used there.

title: String index out of range
explanation: charAt/substring was asked for a position past the end of the string.
where: The indices passed to charAt or substring.

title: Division by zero
explanation: Integer division or % by zero throws in Java.
where: The divisor on the line in the stack trace.

title: Text isn't a number
explanation: Integer.parseInt / Double.parseDouble got text that isn't a valid number (maybe with spaces — try .trim()).
where: The value being parsed.

title: Input doesn't match what Scanner expected
explanation: nextInt() saw something that isn't an int. Check the order you read input in.
where: The Scanner calls and the order of the input.

title: Reading more input than was given
explanation: Scanner ran out of input. Check how many values you read, especially in loops.
where: The Scanner calls, and loop counts.

title: Invalid cast
explanation: You cast an object to a type it isn't.
where: The cast on the line in the stack trace.

title: Recursion never stops
explanation: A method keeps calling itself without reaching its base case.
where: The base case and the recursive call's argument.

title: Out of memory
explanation: The program used more memory than allowed — often a loop that keeps adding to a list forever.
where: Loops that add to collections.

pattern: (Main method not found|does not have a main method|Could not find or load main class)
title: No main method
explanation: Code Dojo runs class Main, which needs: public static void main(String[] args).
where: The class name and the main method's signature.

title: Time limit exceeded
explanation: The program ran too long — usually an infinite loop, or reading input that never arrives.
where: Loop conditions and the loop variable's update.
